locator.text: SwiftShader[^1] is a high-performance CPU-based implementation

consequence: SwiftShader is a CPU Vulkan implementation: WebGPU over it is software, never hardware GPU evidence
excerpt: SwiftShader[^1] is a high-performance CPU-based implementation[^2] of the Vulkan[^3] 1.3 graphics API. Its goal is to provide hardware independence for advanced 3D graphics.
